from vlb_traj import Session
import numpy as np
s=Session()
s.record_start()
p=np.array(s.state()['entities']['button1']['position'], dtype=float)

print('press', s.skill('press', target_pos=p))
print('after', s.status())
a=s.record_stop()
print('actions', a.shape)
if len(a):
    s.save_trajectory(a, '/app/output/trajectory.npz')
    print('saved /app/output/trajectory.npz')
s.close()
PY
